instruction: Buy me a gaming console controller on amazon with a rating over 3.8 and have it delivered to my work address.
notes: Single-app Amazon purchase task. The agent logs into Amazon (username = supervisor email), searches products with query 'gaming console controller' and min_product_rating 3.8 (choosing a result with rating strictly > 3.8 and exact product_type), clears the cart so the order contains exactly one item with quantity 1, adds the product, looks up the 'Work' address id and a payment card id, and places the order. Address/card records are only read, never modified. supervisor-complete-task carries the product and address as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; it is called with no answer.
